result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` is now a second name for `updateLandscape` in the CLI. Its help prints the name you typed, and the README documents both. Nothing is committed.

- **`cli/.../Commands.java`**: added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description, which says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. It is listed in the no-argument overview next to `updateLandscape`, with the same options.
- **`cli/.../CommandLineInterface.java`**: both names dispatch to the same `updateLandscape` method, so behaviour and options are identical. `-help` uses `analyzeLandscape` and its description when that name was typed; `updateLandscape -help` is unchanged.
- **`README.md`**: the README had no command descriptions at all, so I added a short "Commands" section covering both landscape names and a pointer to `-help`. This is a judgment call; trim it if you only wanted existing text edited.

**Verification:** `mvn -o -pl cli compile` and `package -DskipTests` succeed. I ran a temporary JUnit test covering both help outputs, the overview, and `analyzeLandscape -analysisRoot <tmp>`, which created `_sokrates_landscape/config.json` and `index.html`. All four passed. I then deleted the test, so the repo has no new test files. I did not run `java -jar` directly because the sandbox asked for approval; the test exercised the same code path.
